creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07 with the laptop-gone work. While the laptop sleeps with its ssh forward open, every post from a devenv agent to a group kept on the laptop waits out its patience (15 s for a post) and exits 4, again and again, until sshd on the devenv gives up the stalled connection, which can take a long time. The devenv daemon could notice the silent link sooner - a heartbeat on the link, or remembering that the last call went unanswered and refusing at once for a while - so an agent learns in milliseconds rather than paying 15 s per attempt.
title: A devenv daemon could notice a silent link to a sleeping laptop sooner
